subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should OpenClaw accept currentAttemptReplayMetadata as an optional harness result contract and retry classified empty server_error turns before assistant failover for this bug fix?
rationale: The code shape is a narrow fix, but it changes SDK-visible attempt result shape and provider-failure routing in a session/message-delivery-sensitive path.

options.title: Accept after proof
options.body: Require redacted full-runner or gateway proof, then accept the optional field and server-error retry ordering as the canonical fix path.

options.title: Accept risk now
options.body: A maintainer may intentionally accept the compatibility and retry-ordering risk based on the focused tests and terminal transcript alone.

options.title: Consolidate elsewhere
options.body: If maintainers prefer another open candidate such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966, pause this PR and preserve any useful tests or proof there.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted full-runner or gateway proof, then accept the optional field and server-error retry ordering as the canonical fix path.
